scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,display -c gray,cyan --hide shared "bun run --filter @briar/shared dev" "bun run --filter @briar/display dev"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -k -n shared,node -c gray,magenta --hide shared "bun run --filter @briar/shared dev" "bun run --filter @briar/node dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @briar/shared build && bun run --filter @briar/display build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @briar/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @briar/node typecheck && bun run --filter @briar/display typecheck
